thesis: Mohnish Pabrai launched his fund in 1999 after friends requested he manage their money without stock tips, leading him to adopt a Buffett-style limited partnership structure with a 6% hurdle and a 25% performance fee. To ensure he did not negatively impact his friendships, he personally guaranteed the principal and a 6% annual return for his investors, a risk he could absorb because his personal net worth was approximately $10 million at the time.
